A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a good match between education and work is beneficial for the worker, but that this benefit is larger in countries with strong linkage between education and work.
strong linkage reduces unemployment and increases earnings for workers, and that these effects are larger in countries that have a stronger linkage between school and work.
